name: maps-bulk-ingest
description: Bulk dumper triggers for maps coverage acceleration. Each tool POSTs /trigger to the corresponding K8s resident pod and returns 202+job state.

tools.name: maps.bulk.refresh_wikidata
tools.description: Trigger a full Wikidata P625 dump (5M rows, 8-12h). Streams latest-all.json.gz, filters to coord-bearing entities, writes Parquet to B2, COPY into vertex_spatial. Idempotent: collisions silently dropped.

tools.name: maps.bulk.refresh_wikipedia
tools.description: Trigger a full Wikipedia geo_tags dump across 107+ langs (5-15M rows, 4-6h). Per lang: download geo_tags.sql.gz + page.sql.gz, JOIN, parquet, COPY.

langs.description: Optional comma-separated lang codes; default = all 107 in pod env.

tools.name: maps.bulk.refresh_osm_planet
tools.description: Trigger Geofabrik regional PBF dumps (50M rows, 6-10h). Per region: PBF download → osmium tags-filter → geojsonseq export → parquet → COPY.

tools.name: maps.bulk.status
tools.description: Query current dump state across all 3 workers. Returns {wikidata: {...}, wikipedia: {...}, osm_planet: {...}} with running/started_at/rows_written/current_*/error fields.

auth.note: Per ADR-0022 Auth Topology, mutation tools (refresh_*) require ES256 Service Auth JWT with lxm claim matching tool name. status is read-only and public.
